parameters.help_en: The cluster ID. Call instructions: Engine compatibility note: Explicitly list the database types that support SQL throttling, such as PolarDB for MySQL 8.0 only, in the description of the DBClusterId parameter or the API prerequisites
parameters.help_zh: 集群ID。调用说明：引擎兼容性说明：在 DBClusterId 参数 description 或 API 前置条件中明确列出支持 SQL 限流的 DBType（如仅 PolarDB MySQL 8.0）
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the SQL throttling rule. You can specify only one rule name at a time.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/212573.html operation to query the details of all SQL throttling rules in the specified cluster, including the rule names.
If the specified rule name does not exist in the current cluster, the system automatically creates a new SQL throttling rule based on the name and the value of `RuleConfig`
parameters.help_zh:
SQL限流规则名称。一次仅支持输入一个规则名称。
您可以通过接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/212573.html查看目标集群下的所有SQL限流规则详情，包括规则名称。
若输入的规则名称不存在于当前集群中，系统会自动根据该名称和`RuleConfig`值创建一个新的SQL限流规则
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en:
The JSON string of the configuration parameters and their values for the SQL throttling rule to be modified. All parameter values are of the string type. Example: `{"id":"test","enabled":"true","match_mode":"0","template":"dXBkYXRlIHQgc2V0IGEgPSAxIHdoZXJlIGlkID0gMQ==","user":"","database":"","waiting":1024,"endpoint":"[{"EndpointName":"pe-***********","EndpointType":"Cluster","DBEndpointDescription":"Cluster Address"}]","throttle_mode":0,"concurrency":1}`. Parameters:
`"id"`: Required. The name of the throttling rule. The name must meet the following requirements:
The name cannot exceed 30 characters in length.
The name must consist of uppercase letters, lowercase letters, and digits. Call instructions: Complete sub-parameter documentation: Annotate the type, value range, business meaning, and conditional dependencies for each field, such as the enumeration values and meanings of match_mode, the values and meanings of throttle_mode, the valid ranges of waiting and concurrency, and the conditional requirement rules for endpoint
parameters.help_zh:
需要修改的SQL限流规则的配置参数及其值的JSON串，参数的值都是字符串类型，例如：`{"id":"test","enabled":"true","match_mode":"0","template":"dXBkYXRlIHQgc2V0IGEgPSAxIHdoZXJlIGlkID0gMQ==","user":"","database":"","waiting":1024,"endpoint":"[{"EndpointName":"pe-***********","EndpointType":"Cluster","DBEndpointDescription":"Cluster Address"}]","throttle_mode":0,"concurrency":1}`。其中：
`"id"`：必填，限流规则的名称，需满足如下要求：
不能超过30个字符。
必须由大小写字母和数字组成。调用说明：完整子参数文档：逐字段标注类型、取值范围、业务含义和条件依赖（如 match_mode 枚举值及含义、throttle_mode 取值及含义、waiting/concurrency 的有效范围、endpoint 的条件必填规则）
parameters.name: rule_config

If the request is successful, Successful is returned. If the request fails, an error message such as an error code is returned
